posts.title: NetBSD 11.1 Installation with Disk Encryption
posts.description: The first time I installed NetBSD I used sysinst(8) , a menu-based program launched at boot that runs in the console. It has a clear and concise layout and I was quickly up-and-running on my new BSD system.
